title: Build SessionRelayManager — autonomous session relay to prevent context rot without requiring a human to paste a handoff into a new session
description:
Design doc: docs/session-relay-design.md (this repo, on main once the docs PR merges).

Problem: anti-compact's PreCompact-hook approach can only ever block/prompt a human to paste
a handoff into a fresh session — it has no channel to inject a new turn autonomously, and it
only ever sees an estimated (chars/4) context usage, never the CLI's exact
get_context_usage percentage. cc-vscode-ext already owns every primitive needed to fix this
properly: it drives claude via --input-format/--output-format stream-json, already polls
exact get_context_usage per channel (MessageBroker.refreshContextUsage), can hold multiple
concurrent session processes (ClaudeProcessManager, one per channelId), and already has
sendUserMessage() to inject a turn into a live process's stdin.

Scope (see the design doc for full detail, file:line citations, and the permission-prompt
race risk to design around):
- src/relay/SessionRelayManager.ts — watches context_usage, triggers a relay at a
  configurable threshold (~65-70%).
- src/relay/handoffPrompt.ts — anti-compact's handoff SYSTEM_PROMPT, copied verbatim,
  injected via the existing sendUserMessage() rather than a second claude -p process.
- ClaudeProcessManager.swapChannel(channelId, options, cwd) — new method: atomically retire
  the old process handle and spawn the new one under the same channelId in one map mutation.
- New IPC types in types/ipc.ts: a relay_started broadcast + a threshold get/set pair.
- Must check ControlRequestManager for a pending control request (e.g. an in-flight
  tool_permission_request, since this repo launches claude with
  --permission-prompt-tool stdio) before swapping, deferring to the next result event
  rather than force-closing mid-prompt.

PROCESS REQUIREMENT: this is real code, not a docs-only change. It must go through Joe's
normal spec -> superpowers:writing-plans -> superpowers:subagent-driven-development pipeline
before any implementation lands — do not implement directly from this ticket or the design
doc alone.
